name: SeedVR2
description: Temporal AI video restoration using the SeedVR2 ComfyUI extension. Install ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler in ComfyUI first. Uses a 3B Q4 model and tiled VAE; retains source audio and frame rate. Device bindings follow the connected service; for direct ComfyUI use select your GPU in the two loaders.
